units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 22:22">Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 22</cite> <he>למִשְׂטַן</he> (O. <he>לשָׂטָן</he>; ed. Berl. <he>לסָטָן</he>). Ib. 32 <he>למִישְׂטַן</he> (O. ed. Vien. <he>למִסְטַן</he>; ed. Berl. <he>לסָטָן</he>).
Targ. Ps. XXXVIII, 21 סָטְנַן Levita (ed. Af.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 109:4">Ib. CIX, 4</cite> <he>סְטַנוּ</he> (Ms. <he>שַׂטְנוּ</he>); a. e.

senses.gloss: same. Ib. XXXVIII, 21, v. supra.—2) (denom. of same. סָטָן) to mislead.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 20a:1">Yoma 20ᵃ</cite> <he>לית ליה רשותא לאַסְטוּנֵי</he> (not <he>לאיס׳</he>) has no permission to seduce to sin.
